teacherNotes: First review pair after L060. R002 introduces no new characters and must be paired with R001 to cover L001-L030.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, or logos. The fixed young Taiwanese girl stands safely at the edge of a calm body of water. She looks across the water toward a mountain, where birds are visible flying or resting on the mountain. The water edge, mountain, and birds on the mountain should be easy to understand.

Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, or logos. A single small bird flies upward toward the top of a tall mountain. The mountain should clearly look high, with the bird in motion toward the mountain top. Keep the scene simple and readable for a phone screen.

Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, or logos. Clear side-by-side comparison in one outdoor scene. The waterside is crowded with many people and feels busy, while the mountain-side path has only a few people and looks peaceful, open, and pleasant. The fixed young Taiwanese girl prefers the quieter mountain side. Make it clear that the side with fewer people near the mountain is better than the crowded water side.

Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, or logos. Two children walk together toward the front of a door. Their bodies should show forward movement, and the door front should be the clear destination. The scene should feel like one child is going together with the other child to the front door.

Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, or logos. Library or cozy reading corner. A boy and a girl arrive together and begin looking at books. Another child is already reading nearby, so it is visually clear that the boy and girl also came to look at books. Keep book covers blank or decorative without readable text.
